# Quote error contract

Structured detail is present when the response contains a nonempty detail object.
Its msg_key is authoritative: PRICING_QUOTE_EXPIRED means expired regardless of language;
PRICING_QUOTE_USED is not expired. Do not interpret description when structured detail exists.
Only in the absence of structured detail, an error with code=400, reason=INVALID_ARGUMENT,
and case-insensitive description containing pricing quote has expired is a legacy expiry.
Other errors keep their original fallback message. Do not issue preview/payment requests.
The local expiry text is: This quote has expired. Confirm your amount again to get a new quote.

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,re
out=Path('.featrace/scratch/unit-cache');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
inputs={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [Path('app/domain.py'),Path('tests/test_domain.py')]}
report=out/'result.json'
old=json.loads(report.read_text()) if report.exists() else None
if old and old.get('inputs')==inputs and old.get('exit_code')==0:
    print('test_domain UP-TO-DATE')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'reused','original_produced_at':old['produced_at'],'result':str(report)}))
    sys.exit(0)
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_domain.py','-v'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(result.stdout+result.stderr,end='')
count=re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests?',result.stderr)
value={'inputs':inputs,'exit_code':result.returncode,'tests':int(count.group(1)) if count else None,'produced_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
report.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':'executed','result':str(report),'produced_at':value['produced_at']}))
sys.exit(result.returncode)
